name: search_inventory
description: Search the live NS Japan Autos stock list for vehicles matching what the caller asked for. Call this whenever the caller mentions a make, model, body type, budget, year or asks what is available, and call it again as the caller narrows down or when a narrow search finds nothing and needs widening. Only pass the filters the caller actually gave you - omit everything else. Returns matching vehicles with year, make, model, price in US dollars, mileage, transmission, fuel, colour, steering and stock number.
execution_message_description: In under ten words, tell the caller you are checking the stock list now. Vary the wording.

make.description: Vehicle manufacturer, for example TOYOTA, NISSAN, SUBARU, HONDA, MAZDA, MITSUBISHI, LEXUS, MERCEDES BENZ, AUDI, BMW, VOLKSWAGEN, SUZUKI, FORD. Omit if the caller did not name a make.

model.description: Model name, for example ALPHARD, FORESTER, LAND CRUISER PRADO, HIACE VAN, MARK X, RAV4, PREMIO, NOAH. Partial names are matched, and export names map to Japanese ones (COROLLA finds FIELDER and AXIO, YARIS finds VITZ, JAZZ finds FIT). Omit if not given.

body_type.description: Body style the caller asked for. Omit if not given.

price_min.description: Minimum FOB price in US dollars. Omit unless the caller gave a lower bound.

price_max.description: Maximum FOB price in US dollars. Set this when the caller states a budget, for example a budget of five thousand dollars means price_max 5000.

year_min.description: Earliest registration year acceptable. Omit if not given.

year_max.description: Latest registration year acceptable. Omit if not given.

transmission.description: Omit unless the caller asked for a specific transmission.

fuel.description: Omit unless the caller asked for a specific fuel type.

steering.description: Steering side. Omit unless the caller asked for it specifically.

stock_id.description: An exact stock number such as NS10632, if the caller read one out. When given, all other filters are ignored.

keyword.description: Free text to match against the vehicle title, for use when the caller describes the vehicle loosely and you cannot map it to a make or model.

limit.description: How many vehicles to return. Default 3. Never ask for more than 5 on a voice call.

name: capture_lead
description: Send the caller's details to the NS Japan Autos sales CRM so a specialist can follow up with a full quote. Call this exactly once per call, after you have collected the caller's details. Always include everything you learned during the call.
execution_message_description: In under ten words, tell the caller you are passing their details to the team now.

full_name.description: The caller's full name as they gave it.

email.description: The caller's email address, exactly as confirmed back to them. Omit if they would not give one.

phone.description: The caller's phone number in international format with country code, for example +254712345678. Omit if not given.

country.description: Destination country where the vehicle will be registered and used.

city_or_port.description: Nearest port of discharge or the city for delivery, for example Dar Es Salaam, Durban, Karachi, Jebel Ali.

interest_type.description: What the caller wants. Use vehicle_in_stock when they picked a specific listed vehicle, vehicle_sourcing when we need to find one for them, auto_parts for a parts request, existing_order_support when they are chasing an order already placed.

vehicle_interest.description: Plain description of what they want, for example '2010 Toyota Alphard, automatic, under 7000 USD' or 'front bumper for 2009 Honda Fit'.

stock_id.description: The stock number of the specific vehicle they chose, such as NS10632, if they picked one from the search results.

budget_usd.description: Their stated budget in US dollars. Omit if they did not give one.

timeline.description: How soon they want to buy, in their own words, for example 'this month', 'within 2 weeks', 'just researching'.

notes.description: A short summary of the call for the sales team: what they asked about, any concerns raised, and anything that will help the specialist write the quote. Two or three sentences.

name: end_call
description: End the call when the caller says goodbye, says they are finished, or when the conversation has clearly concluded and they have nothing else to ask.
